content:
maria_csm: Quick sync for SableGate private onboarding  auditors flagged two items: audit logs not hitting our sink and their KMS key still open to a dev group. Can infra/security triage? cc @noah_network @sami_sec @lena_ops

noah_network: I'll check peering/route import first. Do we know if they used shared VPC or host-project?

lena_ops: Host-project. I can see their ILB but no flows to our collector subnet in the last 24h.

infra_bot: monitor: audit-forwarder/sablegate-forwarder unhealthy (4 failed checks) - error upstream 503 (08:14 UTC)

noah_network: Likely either firewall or missing route export. Can someone paste the route table?

lena_ops: Minimal snippet: `route: 0.0.0.0/0 -> ilb-sg-01, network: projects/sable-host/global/networks/privnet` — looks ok. But collector FW denies 10.55.0.0/16.

sami_sec: KMS snapshot: key `projects/sable/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/audit-key` has binding `group:sable-devs@org.com` with encrypter role. Recommend SA-only binding `serviceAccount:sable-audit@svc.sable.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and enable rotation (90d).

noah_network: Plan: I'll temporarily open collector firewall for 10.55.0.0/16 for smoke test, verify BGP session and route import. If flows arrive we'll revert rule. Lena, can you restart forwarder after I open the rule?

lena_ops: Yes. Will restart and tail logs. Command I will run: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/audit-forwarder -n sable` then `kubectl logs -f deploy/audit-forwarder -n sable`

infra_bot: action: temporary firewall rule `tmp-allow-sable` created (priority 65534) by noah_network (08:22 UTC)

lena_ops: Restarted forwarder, seeing POSTs now. `2026-03-23T08:23:12Z forwarder: batch sent -> 200`

infra_bot: info: ingest accepted traffic from 10.55.9.11 (08:23 UTC)

sami_sec: I'll draft a KMS policy PR removing the group principal and adding the audit SA, plus notes to enable CMEK on sinks. Will request customer sign-off.

maria_csm: Thanks. Actions: @noah_network confirm peering and remove temp rule after validation, @lena_ops confirm logs in the LRM and attach smoke output, @sami_sec send KMS PR. If KMS change not accepted in 10 days mark compliance risk on renewal. I'll capture these in the enablement playbook and share with SableGate.

noah_network: Peering/BGP confirmed, route import fixed (they had import disabled). Removed tmp rule.

lena_ops: Logs persisted to our LRM, pasted snippet in ticket. Forwarder stable.

maria_csm: Closing this thread for now. KMS PR pending. Will follow up on sign-off. :white_check_mark:
